model.encoder_primary_description: OpenCLIP ViT-bigG-14 laion2b_s39b_b160k, encode_image before L2 normalisation, 224 px
model.decision_rule_addition: P1 in the same direction with both robustness encoders
model.h2_context: contiguous forearm continuity below the wrist, palm widths, capped at 1 (model/context.py; data/context_continuity.json)
model.h2_gate: g = c + (1 - c) a, one parameter c fitted on training sources to the human DH/FB ratio
model.s3_low_level_alternative: global visible-area fraction with the same gate, compared on the matched control pairs
model.motor_regime: observation without execution, per trial: each motor population near 1 Hz on static frames and at rest, below 3 Hz on movement frames (training)
model.readout_validity: every trained network enters except one failing a network-level health criterion; a cell (display x trial type x population) is over-driven when that population's mean pre-probe rate exceeds its own readout range (rate at its excitability-curve peak, measured inside the 0-0.6 sweep); every criterion is computed with over-driven readouts removed and set to the readout maximum, met only if met both ways, not met only if not met both ways, otherwise undetermined
model.readout_trimming: +/- 2 SD within instance x display x trial type x population, then z-normalisation (paper); untrimmed sensitivity
model.h2_gate_fit: grid c in {0, 0.05, ..., 1}, closest source-mean DH/FB ratio to -0.10 on the 19 training sources, ties to smaller c, values with source-mean delta FB <= 0 excluded; fitted raw and under each treatment, the evaluation uses the c of the same treatment; learned pathways cross-fitted on training sources
model.amended: 2026-10-24: readout validity, motor regime, trimming, ungated comparison (docs/analysis-spec.md section 10); 2026-10-26: failing-network rule, readout ranges, criteria implementation, fit under each treatment, Gate 2 checks; 2026-11-10: necessity of the gate, readouts as simulated, sensitivity to c, informative criteria for H2 (independent review)
model.gate2_checks: inner training source only; distinct control predictions: 8 quantities (6 control FDI movement effects, 2 matched-pair differences), paired hierarchical bootstrap, two-sided p < .05 after Holm over the 8, under both treatments, for H0-H1, H0-H2, H1-H2 with the primary encoder; smooth probe responses: full-body trials, probe 1.0-1.5 x threshold, mean FDI readout static and movement Spearman >= 0.9 in every network
model.necessity_of_gate: paired difference C_FDI(H2) - C_FDI(ungated) over matched instances, hierarchical bootstrap, both treatments; the ungated network scored with every criterion (model/criteria.py necessity)
model.readouts_as_simulated: every criterion also reported without either treatment of over-driven cells
model.h2_gate_sensitivity: c+ = largest grid c whose training-source DH/FB ratio stays inside the human 95% interval for every grid value from 0 (model/fit_gate.py sensitivity_c); H2 also evaluated at c+, outside the decision rule
